## Welcome

This app covers the eight lectures of STA520: from the biology (DNA, RNA, proteins, mutations) through genetic association (GWAS) and causal inference (Mendelian randomization) to high-dimensional omics and proteomics. One clinical example runs through the whole course: the **LDLR–PCSK9–LDL cholesterol** pathway.

## How to study with it

1. **Read a lecture.** Every topic section has a status control under its heading: **Not reviewed / Reviewed / Confident**. Click as you go.
2. **Answer the quizzes** inside each lecture and the **why-questions** and **spaced review** at the bottom.
3. **Practise calculations** on the [Exam practice](exam-practice.qmd) page: drills that generate new numbers every time (Benjamini–Hochberg, Bonferroni, Hardy–Weinberg, OR from β, Wald ratio, IVW, log₂FC, quantile normalization, moderated t) plus 26 written exam-style questions with model answers.
4. **Check the [dashboard](dashboard.qmd)** to see what is left, with the instructor-flagged topics listed first.
5. Look up terms in the [glossary](glossary.qmd) or use **search** (top right). Searching "PCSK9" finds it in Lectures 1, 2, 3, 6 and 8.

| Badge | Meaning |

| <span class="flag-badge flag-inferred">📌 Likely exam-relevant (AI-inferred)</span> | Inferred from definitions, formulas and worked examples. **Not confirmed by the instructor.** |
